query: Читай CSV-файлы из директории /data/input/orders/, оставляй только строки где поле status равно COMPLETED, пиши результат в /data/output/completed_orders.csv.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: completed_orders_filter_pipeline
  name: Completed Orders Filter Pipeline
  description: Read CSV files from /data/input/orders/, filter rows where status=COMPLETED,
    write result to /data/output/completed_orders.csv
triggers:
- id: trigger_main
  type: manual
  condition: on demand
sources:
- id: source_orders_csv
  name: Read Orders CSV Files
  type: CSV
  location: /data/input/orders/
  connection:
    properties:
      path: /data/input/orders/
      file_pattern: '*.csv'
      has_header: 'true'
      encoding: UTF-8
processing_elements:
- id: process_filter_completed
  name: Filter Completed Orders
  operation: Filter
  config:
    condition: status == 'COMPLETED'
sinks:
- id: sink_completed_orders_csv
  name: Write Completed Orders CSV
  type: CSV
  location: /data/output/completed_orders.csv
  connection:
    properties:
      path: /data/output/completed_orders.csv
      has_header: 'true'
      encoding: UTF-8
      write_mode: overwrite
processed_data:
- id: orders_csv_data
  format: csv
- id: completed_orders_csv_data
  format: csv
links:
- from_id: source_orders_csv
  to_id: process_filter_completed
  data_ref: orders_csv_data
- from_id: process_filter_completed
  to_id: sink_completed_orders_csv
  data_ref: completed_orders_csv_data

error.details:
Trigger(s) ['trigger_main'] have type 'manual'.
The flow will NOT start automatically in NiFi — someone must press Run in the NiFi UI.
Change trigger type to 'schedule' or 'event' for production use.
